keyword.en: concrete pump outlet pressure vs pumping pressure
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵出口压力和泵送压力怎么区分

title.en: Outlet Pressure and Pumping Pressure on Pinjin Sheets keeps its own figures; Hydrostatics is only the picture
title.zh: 品锦参数页上的出口压力和泵送压力保留自己的数字，「流体静力学」只是配图

description.en: Outlet Pressure and Pumping Pressure on Pinjin Sheets. 10 MPa stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Hydrostatics.
description.zh: 品锦参数页上的出口压力和泵送压力。10 MPa仍在目录格子里。插图来自「流体静力学」。

h1.en: Outlet Pressure and Pumping Pressure on Pinjin Sheets keeps its own figures; Hydrostatics is only the picture
h1.zh: 品锦参数页上的出口压力和泵送压力保留自己的数字，「流体静力学」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists pressure in MPa on most concrete pumps made in Xingtai, but the label is not one phrase. Trailer rows such as Electric 20 and Diesel 30 say max. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的多数混凝土泵以 MPa 标出压力，但标题不是同一句话。电动20、柴油30这类拖泵行写最大出口压力。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics. The picture shows Hydrostatics. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists pressure in MPa on most concrete pumps made in Xingtai, but the label is not one phrase. The words are not a conversion factor. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. LZ-60 lists pumping pressure 35 MPa. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW and 380 V, and it does not list a pressure. It is not a blockage-clearing procedure, and it is not a slump specification except where a page actually lists slump.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics。画面是Hydrostatics。河北品锦机械在邢台的多数混凝土泵以 MPa 标出压力，但标题不是同一句话。HBT8018 的泵送压力为 40 MPa。B500S-83D 标出了 7.5 kW 和 380 V，没有标出压力。如果工况需要参数页没有的压力，请走联系页。

heading.en: Hydrostatics in ancient Greece and Rome
heading.zh: 古希腊与古罗马的流体静力学

body.en: Trailer rows such as Electric 20 and Diesel 30 say max. Read the label before the number. Electric 80 lists 40 MPa. The tractor and the rural diesel pump list pumping pressure 15 MPa. Do not copy 10 MPa from Electric 20 onto either page. Only the Tractor-Driven 4100 lists slump, 180–220 mm.
body.zh: 电动20、柴油30这类拖泵行写最大出口压力。拖拉机泵和农村柴油泵的泵送压力为 15 MPa。不要把电动20的 10 MPa 抄到这两页。

heading.zh: 帕斯卡对流体静力学的贡献

body.en: HBT8018, HBT80-16, LZ-60, LZ-80, the tractor pump and the rural diesel pump say pumping pressure. Electric 20 lists max. Diesel 120 lists 40 MPa. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list bar on these concrete pump rows. A missing pressure entry stays blank. Ask through the contact page if a job needs a pressure the sheet does not show.
body.zh: HBT8018、HBT80-16、LZ-60、LZ-80、拖拉机泵和农村柴油泵写泵送压力。河北品锦机械没有在这些混凝土泵行上标出 bar。它不是清堵步骤，也不是坍落度，除非该页真的标出了坍落度。

heading.zh: 液体（有自由表面的流体）

body.en: Electric 15 and B500S-83D list no pressure row. outlet pressure 10 MPa. HBT8018 lists pumping pressure 40 MPa. Electric 15 lists motor power, output and distance ranges, and it does not list a pressure. The shown MPa is the catalogue entry for that concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动15和 B500S-83D 没有压力行。电动15标出了电机、产量和距离范围，没有标出压力。只有拖拉机带动4100标出了坍落度 180–220 mm。

question.en: On this row: Do outlet pressure and pumping pressure convert by a published factor?
question.zh: 出口压力和泵送压力有公布的换算系数吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists one label or the other on each Xingtai concrete pump page. There is no factor telling you to turn one phrase into the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械在每台邢台混凝土泵上只标出其中一个标题。没有系数让你把一种说法换成另一种。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Which compact pumps omit pressure?

answer.en: Electric 15 and B500S-83D do not list a pressure row. The rural diesel pump does list 15 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics.
answer.zh: 电动15和 B500S-83D 没有压力行。农村柴油泵标出了 15 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 压力用 bar 标出吗？

answer.en: Concrete pump rows cited here list MPa. Do not rewrite a entry into bar. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics.
answer.zh: 这里引用的混凝土泵行以 MPa 写出。不要把格子改写成 bar。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does a higher MPa on one model apply to the next model?
question.zh: 一个型号更高的 MPa 能用到下一个型号吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 lists 40 MPa and Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. Keep each figure on its own page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics.
answer.zh: 不能。电动80标出 40 MPa，电动60标出 35 MPa。数字留在各自页面。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrostatics画面里印出的数字。
